# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000 mAh and 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- It costs $54.99 on Anker's site, with a $5 auto-applied discount that was ending soon.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and says it's thin, feels premium, and runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Best slim 10,000 mAh with the fastest charging: INIU SnapGo Air 10K**
- It supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 can use, plus 45W wired charging and a lanyard-style 60W cable.
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195 g, so it's thicker than the 5K models. Macworld lists INIU's 10K model among the slimmest 10K banks.
- Android Central shows $42.99 at Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. I wasn't given a direct product link, so check the current price through the review: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge). See also [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Thinnest and lightest, but slower: Baseus Picogo Air AM71**
- Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the bunch at about 0.27" and 104 g, with 5,000 mAh.
- Wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it will top up your iPhone 17 slowly. Choose it only if size matters more than speed.
- It's $52.99 at Amazon per the review, and I don't have a direct product link: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, Qi2.2)**
- It charges the iPhone 17 at 25W wirelessly and has 45W wired output. It's $53.99 with code AM52.
- The source gives no thickness or weight, so I can't confirm it's slim.
- [Buy from Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link.

**Which to choose**
- A 5K bank like the Anker gets you about 60–75% of a charge, per Macworld. It's the better pick if you want something that disappears in a pocket.
- A 10K bank like the INIU can charge an iPhone close to twice, and it's the better pick for travel or long days.
- Skip the LISEN P601. It's slim at 0.38", but the listing I found is a wholesale page with a 100-unit minimum, not a consumer store.

Prices come from the articles and store pages above and may have changed.
